custom.label: Glossary adherence
custom.instruction: Every term in the work's glossary must be rendered the way the glossary says, every time. Flag a term translated two different ways in one work, or against the glossary entry.

custom.label: Register consistency
custom.instruction: Flag a passage whose formality drifts from the source: a formal address rendered casually, or plain speech rendered literary.

custom.label: Untranslated fragment
custom.instruction: Flag any run of source-language text left in the translation that is not a deliberate proper noun or quoted term.
